newsitem.title: HONG KONG: AsiaSat unit signs lease with ZakSat.
newsitem.headline: AsiaSat unit signs lease with ZakSat.

text.p: Hong Kong-based Asia Satellite Telecommunications Co Ltd (AsiaSat) and Kuwait's ZakSat said on Friday they signed a deal allowing ZakSat to offer internet services through AsiaSat's second satellite.
ZakNet, a wholly owned subsidiary of ZakSat, will offer internet and multi media services from a 36 MHz C-band transponder on AsiaSat 2, the second satellite of AsiaSat.
The services are expected to start by mid-1997.
"With the joining of ZakSat, AsiaSat is now serving more and more customers from the Middle East," said Peter Jackson, AsiaSat's chief executive officer.
AsiaSat 2 has a C-band footprint covering 53 countries in Asia, Middle East, Eastern Europe, Australia and part of the C.I.S.
ZakSat is a joint venture formed in Kuwait in 1996 between Zaid Al Kazemi Sons Trading and Kuwait Projects and Investment Company.
AsiaSat is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Asia Satellite Telecommunications Holdings Ltd.
